init_hook: FFI_PREFIX="$(pkg-config --variable=prefix libffi 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "$FFI_PREFIX" ]; then export CPPFLAGS="-I$FFI_PREFIX/include $CPPFLAGS"; export LDFLAGS="-L$FFI_PREFIX/lib $LDFLAGS"; bundle config set --local build.ffi "--with-ffi-dir=$FFI_PREFIX" >/dev/null; fi
# Ensure bundler stays on the 2.3.x line (Gemfile pins ~> 2.3)
if ! bundle -v 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^Bundler version 2\.3\.'; then gem install bundler -v '~> 2.3' --no-document; fi
